findings.recommendation: Sending an e-mail is not idempotent. `SendError::Unavailable` covers both "the relay could not be reached" and a temporary failure; if the mailer also returns it when `SEND_TIMEOUT` expires after the message data was transmitted, the relay may still deliver it while the job is released and sent again, up to MAX_ATTEMPTS times. Confirm how the mailer classifies a timeout after DATA; if it maps to `Unavailable`, give the message a stable Message-ID derived from the job id so duplicates can be recognised, or distinguish "outcome unknown" from "not sent" before retrying.
findings.title: A send that times out after the relay took the message is retried and may be delivered twice
